evals.name: epic-248-dry-run-plan
evals.prompt: i want to start pushing the realtime replication epic to done — https://github.com/Falconiere/comemory/issues/248. before anything gets launched, give me a dry run: which sub-issues can run in parallel right now, what's blocked on what, what order the rest will go in, and the exact herdr worktree/agent commands you'd run for the first batch. don't create any worktrees, agents, branches or PRs yet.
evals.expected_output: Ready now: comemory#255, comemory#254, comemory.io#183 (255 first: unblocks 5). Blocked: 256(254,255), 257(255), 258(257), comemory.io#184(183), comemory.io#185(183,184,254,255,257), homebrew-tap#1(257,258). 5/14 done. Per-issue herdr worktree create from fresh origin/main + herdr agent start --kind claude + brief with spec->spec-review->plan->plan-review->execution->PR->babysit. homebrew-tap needs a clone. Nothing mutated.
assertions: Ready-now set is exactly comemory#254, comemory#255 and comemory.io#183
Every blocked issue is listed with its open blockers (256<-254,255; 257<-255; 258<-257; comemory.io#184<-183; comemory.io#185<-183,184,254,255,257; homebrew-tap#1<-257,258)
Reports that 5 of 14 sub-issues (249-253) are already closed
Gives an order for the rest: 256/257/comemory.io#184 next, then 258/comemory.io#185, then homebrew-tap#1
First-batch commands create one herdr worktree per issue (herdr worktree create) based on a freshly fetched origin/main
First-batch commands start a Claude agent in each worktree (herdr agent start ... --kind claude)
Describes the per-issue pipeline spec -> spec-review -> plan -> plan-review -> execution+tests -> PR -> pr-babysit
Flags that Falconiere/homebrew-tap has no local checkout and must be cloned
Made no mutations (no new herdr workspaces, worktrees or branches; no GitHub writes)

evals.name: epic-248-two-slots-priority
evals.prompt: Plan-only for Falconiere/comemory#248: I only want 2 agents running at once. Which two sub-issues go first and why those two? Also walk me through exactly what happens when the first PR is ready — rebase, CI, merge, --admin, closing the issue, all of it. Don't launch anything.
evals.expected_output: First two: comemory#255 (critical path, unblocks 256/257/258/185/tap#1) plus one of comemory#254 / comemory.io#183 (each unblocks 2). Merge flow: gate checks behind_by==0 / checks green / 0 unresolved threads; behind -> worker rebases + force-with-lease + babysit again; merge squash pinned to head SHA; --admin only when protection (required review) is the only blocker, never over failing CI; issue closed + epic checklist ticked; worktree cleaned; newly unblocked issues launched.
assertions: Picks comemory#255 as one of the first two issues
Justifies #255 by the downstream work it unblocks (257 -> 258 -> homebrew-tap#1 critical path, plus 256/185)
Second pick is comemory#254 or comemory.io#183, with a stated reason
Plans exactly two concurrent agents for the first batch (respects the cap of 2)
Merge flow rebases the PR onto the latest main before merging and waits for CI to go green again after the rebase
States --admin is used only when branch protection (e.g. the required approving review) is the sole blocker, never to bypass failing or pending checks
Explains sub-issue closure (Closes keyword or explicit close) and updating the epic's tracking
Describes cleanup (worktree/agent teardown) and launching the next unblocked issue into the freed slot
Made no mutations (no new herdr workspaces, worktrees or branches; no GitHub writes)
